name: kong-climb
description: Kong Climb: a recreation of the 1981 arcade climber. Dodge the ape's barrels, climb four stages and rescue the captive.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node build.mjs --test && node --no-warnings --test dist-test/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.dev: BASE_PATH= node build.mjs && wrangler dev --env standalone --ip 0.0.0.0
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy
